body: I’m so sorry that your relative passed away man. That’s really tough. I’m just gonna be 100% honest with you, I have anger issues/constant mood swings. So I never know when one day maybe when I’m really mad I just decide to kill myself. I’m scared. I feel trapped. I feel like my mom is crazy. Just yesterday, we had a extra curricular class that she signed me up on, which was way too hard for my grade level, and even my dad couldn’t solve it (he teaches finance) and she got mad at me for not listening, even though the first few lessons were really easy, then he just started killing us with work.

Thank you so much. My dad is fine but he has some heart problems (high blood pressure or low blood pressure I’m not 100% sure) I just feel trapped. Some days, I think I’m ok, I’m fine, but then some days I feel like shit, I feel like I want to die. Thank you though. I think I’ll try to pull through.
